requirements.statement: Support status is computed on every read from support_end_date and the UTC (test) clock; no supported flag is stored.
An SBOM replacement is one transaction; a rejected SBOM leaves the stored inventory unchanged.
Nested inventory components are flattened recursively; metadata and tool components are excluded.
The vulnerability query distinguishes known-unaffected, unknown CVE and unavailable source.
Deadline statuses are derived from stored timestamps and the clock at read time; there is no timer component.
Each successful change writes its audit event in the same transaction; failed changes, reads and test controls write none.
